cases.expected: A new 20 m pipe with free ends and levels 18.000 / 17.900 has its flow arrow pointing from the first end to the second (arrow block rotation 0). CDEDIT with the levels typed 17.900 / 18.000 and Save prints "Pipe updated." and turns the arrow round (rotation about 3.1416: the pipe now falls from its second end), or says in plain words that the pipe flows uphill; it never ends uphill with no word. The same for a second pipe drawn 0.50 / 0.00 and edited to 0.00 / 0.50. The IL texts read the typed levels at the ends (IL 17.900 left and IL 18.000 right; IL 0.00 left and IL 0.50 right). No CE window is left open and the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The levels, the arrow block and the IL texts are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: Which way the arrow points is read from the arrow block rotation (0 = along the drawn direction, about 3.1416 = turned round); that the picture looks right is a Codex look. The size-only save is in R32b. BUG-261 and BUG-292 (a CD direction question, a plain save reversing a downstream-first pipe) are not claimed here. Pipes on pits (levels from the pits) are not driven.
